articles.title: editorial
articles.summary: This is the first issue of proud magazine, which aims to provide a guide for living in Berlin. The editorial team defines itself with an ironic twist on professions ending in "-ist" and invites readers to join them on a journey of glamour, style, sex, and yoga, with the ultimate goal of taking over the city. It ends with the slogans "Be Berlin. Be proud." and a date and location from Hong Kong.

articles.title: très bonjour fashion show 2008
articles.summary: This article covers the 2008 Très Bonjour Fashion Show, highlighting its unique latex couture lingerie and swimwear collections by designer Viola Jaeger, complemented by extravagant hat creations from Hat-Affairs. The event featured immersive lighting by Mark Beversdorf and 3D projections by Till Nowak, with notable guests like Peaches and Estelle attending the after-party. The article expresses anticipation for future collaborations and the upcoming showroom opening in Berlin.

articles.title: love in berlin
articles.summary: This article interviews Berlin-based graphic designer and illustrator Christian Rothenhagen, known as “deerBLN,” who uses intricate tile art to beautify the city. He discusses his motivations, Berlin's unique character, his views on street art, and his recent exhibition tour in California.

articles.title: pentagonik
articles.summary: This article features an interview with Don and Kai, two of the founders of Pentagonik, a Berlin-based netlabel established in 2005. They discuss the origins and philosophy of Pentagonik, which combines the distribution of free electronic music with organizing parties. The conversation covers the evolution of music distribution, the role of physical music formats, and the netlabel's approach to artist selection.
